First, I'll parse the SVG path data. The path consists of a series of line-to commands (L) connecting points:

1. Start at (50.91,18.41)  
2. Line to (57.39,58.34)  
3. Line to (25.82,45.12)  
4. Line to (33.11,31.36)  
5. Line to (26.90,27.04)  
6. Line to (29.87,20.84)  
7. Line to (50.91,18.41) — closing back to the start.

Counting the points:  
(50.91,18.41) → (57.39,58.34) → (25.82,45.12) → (33.11,31.36) → (26.90,27.04) → (29.87,20.84) → back to (50.91,18.41).  

That’s 6 distinct vertices before returning to the start, so it’s a closed polygon with 6 sides — a hexagon.

Final answer: (C)
